$comment: Work items for coding agents (see docs/agents/README.md). Statuses: not-started | in-progress | blocked | done. A done item needs evidence; an in-progress item needs its branch (name without any account/user prefix), and a branch owns at most one in-progress item. Items stay in id order: insert a new item at its sorted position, edit only your own item, and on a rebase conflict keep both items with unique ids. No item authorizes a commit, push, version bump, release or publication. Contract: test/agent-harness-*.test.ts.

features.name: Agent harness: non-blocking review notes
features.description: Minor notes from the agent-harness skeptic review: init.sh compares pwd -P with git rev-parse --show-toplevel, so a differently-cased path on case-insensitive APFS skips the git checks with only a notice (check that git rev-parse --show-prefix is empty instead); CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md are within ~200 bytes of the 12 KiB budget; the contract's Dockerfile.test COPY parser reads single-line COPY only (fails closed); the inline-code stripper in the link check can mis-pair double-backtick spans; a done item is only checked for non-empty evidence; branch names without the account prefix can collide across users in the one-item-per-branch check.

features.name: Revisit the Python 3.9 SDK runner pin
features.description: The SDK workflow's Python 3.9 job runs on ubuntu-24.04 because ubuntu-latest (Ubuntu 26.04) has no setup-python 3.9 build. Python 3.9 has been end-of-life since October 2025 and the ubuntu-24.04 image will be retired: decide when to drop 3.9 from the supported SDK runtimes (a release-compatibility decision for the user) or move the job to a container image that still ships it.

features.name: CI-script tests survive a Bun-only Machine
features.description: test/repro-docker-version-gate-errors.test.ts and test/repro-release-source-commit.test.ts run CI's version-gate bash, which calls node -p; in the documented Bun-only OrbStack Machine (docs/testing.md, node absent) they fail with node: command not found (6 tests), while CI and the sandbox (oven/bun node fallback) have node. Make them run the gate everywhere, e.g. by prepending a temporary node link to process.execPath on the PATH of the spawned bash, as the reviewer suggested, without weakening what they assert; then the release Machine gate needs no known-gap exception.

features.name: Cron test fails when the unit suite crosses midnight UTC
features.description: test/cronScheduler.test.ts:819 ("cron with both schedule and repeatEvery uses schedule for nextRun") expects the next midnight to be more than 60 s away and fails when the unit suite crosses 23:59 UTC: sandbox run artifacts/test-sandbox/2026-11-12T23-56-09.256Z/ in the agent-skills worktree, unit 11739 pass / 1 fail at 23:59:13 UTC. Reproduce first (a deterministic test that fails at 23:59:xx), then fix with an injected clock or a schedule that cannot be less than 60 s away, without weakening what the test asserts.

features.name: Reload the TLS certificate on SIGHUP without a restart
features.description: Issue 189: a renewed certificate on disk was only served after a restart, and SIGHUP killed the process. With TLS configured, SIGHUP re-reads TLS_CERT_FILE/TLS_KEY_FILE, validates the pair and moves the TCP and HTTP listeners to it all-or-nothing, keeping open connections on their certificate and rolling back on failure.

features.name: Unix-socket rollback follow-ups from the issue 189 review
features.description: Two non-blocking skeptic notes on src/infrastructure/server/httpListener.ts: (1) on the rollback rebind of the HTTP unix socket, a chown failure other than EPERM throws before chmodSync runs, so the previous mode is not restored either; (2) the two new warning paths (owner/group not restored, rollback permissions not restored) have no test. Write the reproducing tests first, then fix.

features.name: bun pm pack ignores the !dist/benchmark negation of package.json files
features.description: package.json files lists dist/**/*.js, dist/**/*.d.ts and the negations !dist/bunqueue and !dist/benchmark. npm 11.20.0 honors !dist/benchmark, but bun pm pack 1.4.4 (what CI packs with) still packs dist/benchmark/*.js and *.d.ts when that directory exists (root-cleanup evidence: 1,750 files with a probe dist/benchmark/, 1,748 without; with "!dist/benchmark/**" added to files Bun packs 0 of them). It is latent, not live: tsconfig.build.json excludes src/benchmark/**, so build:lib never emits dist/benchmark and CI's tarball is correct today. test/agent-harness-state.test.ts models files with npm semantics (publishedByFiles), so it does not see the difference. Write a test that packs with bun pm pack --dry-run after creating a probe file under dist/benchmark and fails today, then add the !dist/benchmark/** negation (or drop the dead negations) and keep the published list byte-identical for a normal build.
